paragraph: Today’s Granville composite registers a hesitant 50 out of 100, capped firmly at 60 due to an active divergence warning where the broader market is rising even as the equal-weight RSP-to-SPY breadth ratio falls by 0.56%. Under this mixed technical umbrella, internal leadership flashes stark contrasts, highlighted by a strong +1.88% surge in high beta versus low volatility (SPHB/SPLV) and a +1.77% outperformance in bellwether semis, which directly offset ongoing weakness in transport underperformance (-0.66%). Macro conditions provide a steady backdrop to digest these internal tug-of-war signals, anchored by an elevated VIX at 20.72 alongside stable high-yield credit spreads holding firm at 3.43% and a 10-year real yield parked at 2.60%. Given the technical ceiling imposed by narrowing market breadth against stable macroeconomic credit conditions, the session points to a choppy, range-bound directional lean with a slight defensive bias.
